term: unrestricted fusion in a fixed partial-order domain
definition: A fusion is an upper bound for the selected nonempty family, every part of which overlaps a selected member. Overlap means a common part. Unrestricted requires this for every nonempty Set of the fixed carrier. Composite means having a strict part. Body instantiates the order by subset inclusion on nonempty subsets of Bool.
note: Analyst scope profile for #328, motivated by the materialized Varzi exposition. All-subset quantification is an explicit second-order mathematical choice; neither causal sufficiency nor metaphysical adequacy is attributed to the source. See docs/notes/universal-fusion-grounding.md.
